notice.title: The Bell Marches
notice.text: Battle Master is set in an invented land. The fair at Fifth Bell opens one week each year, and five commanders stand between your wagon train and the right to ring its bell. Every name, place and regiment is fictional. Each march is different: the road forks, rewards change, and every rival is built from the same budget you earned.
notice.source: An original world. No history is claimed.
